# VU Research Portal

> Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam's research portal providing open access to researcher profiles, publications, and academic collaboration tools with full accessibility compliance.

The VU Research Portal serves as the central hub for discovering and accessing research from Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam. The portal emphasizes open access principles and maintains comprehensive accessibility standards including WCAG 2.1 AA compliance and support for assistive technologies.

## Key Topics

- Open Access
- Researcher Profiles
- Publications
- Academic Repository
- Research Portal
- WCAG Compliance
- Screen Reader Support
- Keyboard Navigation
- Accessibility Standards
- Disability Access
- Web Standards
- Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam

## Research Portal

- [Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam](https://research.vu.nl): VU Research Portal homepage showcasing researcher profiles, publications, and open access research

## Accessibility & Compliance

- [Accessibility statement for Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam](https://research.vu.nl/en/web-accessibility): WCAG compliance and accessibility statement for screen readers and keyboard navigation
